title: Dark Ancestor
description: Dengeir of Stuhn asks you to destroy his vampire ancestor Vighar, who escaped his grave and fled to Bloodlet Throne, to protect his family from shame.

base_facts: I am a former Jarl of Falkreath.
My ancestor Vighar was a vampire, bound in his grave by a wardstone for centuries.
Someone stole the wardstone and Vighar escaped to Bloodlet Throne.
I want Vighar destroyed before anyone discovers my family's secret shame.

DENGEIR_REVEALS_ANCESTOR: I have asked someone to destroy my vampire ancestor Vighar at Bloodlet Throne.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My vampire ancestor Vighar has been destroyed. My family's secret shame is safe from discovery.
I paid the player 200 gold for destroying Vighar and protecting my family's honor.
My disposition toward the player has increased by one rank; they have proven trustworthy with my family's darkest secret.
The open grave in Falkreath's graveyard will no longer threaten my family's reputation among the townsfolk.

base_facts: I am a powerful vampire and the ancestor of Dengeir of Stuhn.
I was imprisoned in my grave by a wardstone until someone stole it.
I now reside at Bloodlet Throne in the mountains southwest of Helgen.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I was destroyed by the player in my arena at Bloodlet Throne after releasing wolves and attacking alongside my vampire companions.
My death means Dengeir's family secret is safe; no one in Falkreath will learn that his ancestor was a vampire.

beats.comment: Dengeir reveals his family secret about his vampire ancestor Vighar and asks the player to destroy him at Bloodlet Throne.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to destroy the vampire Vighar and protect Dengeir's family from shame.
examples_yes: I will destroy him for you.
examples_no: I don't want to get involved.

beats.comment: Vighar has been killed at Bloodlet Throne. The game advances to stage 20.
Player returns to Dengeir and reports Vighar's death. Quest completes at stage 200.
